evidence_containers.body: This local simulated evidence container records one fixture status: the declared review status is local-only and is tied only to evidence-serp-0001. It represents a constructed planning input, not a provider response, customer record, clinical finding, Google result, external-tool output, or production activity. Use it in the evidence section after the direct answer and context, then explain that a reviewer must confirm any final local facts before publication. Do not turn this status into proof of service quality, availability, outcomes, suitability, or endorsement. Attribute the statement to this local simulated briefing, keep the uncertainty visible, and leave unsupported details out. Place the CTA after the limitations, with an internal link to the verified local service overview. Final reviewers should check wording, evidence placement, and the local-only label before approval for publication.
